item.title: Indonesian Vice President Resigns After Education Eligibility Rulings
item.description: Reuters reports that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka tendered his resignation, according to an aide, after court rulings found his education documents did not establish his eligibility for the 2024 election. Parliament must still formally declare the vacancy before choosing a replacement from two presidential nominees.
item.dc:creator: www.bangkokpost.com

item.title: Spain’s First General Strike in 14 Years Targets Housing Crisis
item.description: Reuters reports that Spanish workers staged the country’s first general strike in 14 years to demand action on housing affordability, delaying public transport and slowing factories. The walkout came less than three weeks before a snap national election.
item.dc:creator: South China Morning Post

item.title: Gibran Resignation Prospect Raises Stakes for Indonesia’s Coalition
item.description: State Secretary Prasetyo Hadi said President Prabowo Subianto had been informed of Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka’s intention to resign, but no formal resignation letter had been submitted. Analysts told the South China Morning Post that a departure could trigger a contest for the vice-presidency and further weaken former president Joko Widodo’s influence.
item.dc:creator: South China Morning Post
